title: 9 August 1963: Live: Springfield Ballroom, Jersey
content:
Following their sole concert on the island of Guernsey the night before, The Beatles flew back to Jersey on 9 August 1963. In the evening they gave the third of four concerts in Jersey.

The promoter was Les De La Mare, who paid £1,000 for the five Channel Islands bookings.
